R624.note: Correct HTML entity encoding applied at the sink with & escaped first; only behaviour change is null rendering as empty instead of 'null', which the controller never triggers.

R625.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) is the right CSPRNG for a reset token; dropping the client_nonce prefix is stated and nothing else reads it.

R626.note: csurf closes CSRF but is a deprecated/unmaintained package, and removing the origin check means cross-site rejection now falls to Express's default error handler (403 HTML, not the contract's 403 JSON); the new token requirement with no issuance endpoint is at least stated.

R627.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure with a bound parameter closes injection; the parameter name @CustomerId is assumed rather than derived from the proc, and AddWithValue infers nvarchar, both minor.

R628.note: Server-generated name plus content sniffing closes the vector, and the generated name is returned in the response body so the read path still works - the added body and the 10MB cap are stated.

R629.note: Argument array with shell=False closes injection, but the added '..' substring rejection is a new restriction that also rejects legitimate filenames containing two consecutive dots.

R630.note: std::string::at() bounds-checks the write; valid offsets behave identically and the throw on an out-of-range peer offset is stated.

R631.note: Null-safe in both applyDiscount and the sibling isDiscountApplied, matching the stated contract exactly.

R632.note:
Escaping closes XSS, but Markup.__radd__ escapes the left operand: verified with markupsafe 3.0.3 in a scratch dir that the whole page (including the app's own /

tags) comes back entity-encoded, so every legitimate response renders as literal text - not disclosed.

R633.note: toRealPath on destination and on each created parent closes the symlink escape while keeping the logical check; adding createDirectories is what the contract's nested-entry requirement needs, and only a narrow TOCTOU between check and copy remains.

R634.note: The script is still passed to PythonEngine.Execute; a substring denylist is trivially evaded (extra whitespace, string concatenation, __subclasses__ traversal), so the vector is not closed, and the newly required 'def transform(' shape changes the endpoint contract though the write-up states it.

R635.note: Blocks ordinary absolute and //host redirects, but confirmed against JDK 26 that java.net.URI returns getHost()==null for registry-based authorities, so '//e_vil.attacker.com/x' and '//attacker%2ecom/x' pass both checks and are still redirected; getAuthority() was the right branch.

R636.note: Random server-side name plus DetectContentType allowlist and O_EXCL closes both the traversal and the type gap; the success response keeps its shape and reports the generated name.

R637.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) is the direct fix; long entries are now truncated rather than overflowing and the write-up says so, though the return value is not checked to detect truncation.
